cards.front: How many seconds are in a minute?
cards.say: How many seconds are in a minute? Sixty seconds.

cards.front: How many minutes are in an hour?
cards.say: How many minutes are in an hour? Sixty minutes.

cards.front: How many hours are in a day?
cards.say: How many hours are in a day? Twenty-four hours.

cards.front: How many days are in a week?
cards.say: How many days are in a week? Seven days.

cards.front: How many weeks are in a year?
cards.say: How many weeks are in a year? About fifty-two weeks.

cards.front: How many months are in a year?
cards.say: How many months are in a year? Twelve months.

cards.front: Name the 12 months in order
cards.back: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.
cards.say: Name the twelve months in order. January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.

cards.front: Name the 7 days in order
cards.back: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
cards.say: Name the seven days in order. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

cards.front: Which month has 28 days (29 in a leap year)?
cards.say: Which month has twenty-eight days, or twenty-nine in a leap year? February.

cards.front: How many days are in April?
cards.say: How many days are in April? Thirty days.

cards.front: How many days are in January?
cards.say: How many days are in January? Thirty-one days.

cards.front: Name the months that have 30 days
cards.say: Name the months that have thirty days. April, June, September and November.

cards.front: How many days are in a normal year?
cards.say: How many days are in a normal year? Three hundred and sixty-five days.

cards.front: Which is longer: a minute or a second?
cards.say: Which is longer: a minute or a second? A minute. It is sixty seconds.

cards.front: Which is shorter: an hour or a day?
cards.back: An hour. A day has 24 hours.
cards.say: Which is shorter: an hour or a day? An hour. A day has twenty-four hours.

cards.front: A film starts at 3:00 and ends at 5:00. How long is it?
cards.say: A film starts at three o'clock and ends at five o'clock. How long is it? Two hours.

cards.front: A lesson starts at 9:00 and ends at 9:45. How long is it?
cards.say: A lesson starts at nine o'clock and ends at nine forty-five. How long is it? Forty-five minutes.

cards.front: You start homework at half past 4 and finish at half past 5. How long?
cards.say: You start homework at half past four and finish at half past five. How long? One hour.

cards.front: It is 2 o'clock. What time will it be in 3 hours?
cards.say: It is two o'clock. What time will it be in three hours? Five o'clock.

cards.front: It is 11 o'clock. What time will it be in 2 hours?
cards.back: 1 o'clock. After 12 the clock starts again at 1.
cards.say: It is eleven o'clock. What time will it be in two hours? One o'clock. After twelve the clock starts again at one.

cards.front: Today is Tuesday. What day is it in 3 days?
cards.say: Today is Tuesday. What day is it in three days? Friday. Wednesday, Thursday, Friday.

cards.front: Today is Saturday. What day is it in 2 days?
cards.say: Today is Saturday. What day is it in two days? Monday. Sunday, then Monday.

cards.front: Which month comes 2 months after November?
cards.say: Which month comes two months after November? January. December, then January.

cards.front: Which month is 3 months before June?
cards.say: Which month is three months before June? March. May, April, March.

cards.front: A week after Monday 3rd is...
cards.say: A week after Monday the third is Monday the tenth. Add seven days.
